batch: RNA-Based Representation Ownership, Batch 1 (user prompt 2026-10-12): can a high-quality RNA-style model be decomposed into independently owned surface-domain representations without losing the ability to reproduce the original scene's radiance?
written: before any training of this batch; nothing of configuration C2 exists yet

rna.unchanged: every upstream file; the batch imports rna.models.NeuralSurfaceTriPlane, rna.interfaces.NeuralSurfaceTriplaneModule / NeuralSurfaceDataModule, rna.datasets.NeuralSurfaceDataset and subclasses them in experiments/rna_surface_ownership

code_facts.learned_state: NeuralSurfaceTriPlane: TriplaneFeatures (three PlaneFeatureGrid parameters, C=8 x 512 x 512, Gaussian-blurred with sigma 8 -> min 1.0 over 20 000 iterations, wrap blur) + ConfigurableMLP (17 -> 512, 4 x 512, -> 6: lit and shadowed RGB)
code_facts.optimisation: Lightning NeuralSurfaceModule: one view (all masked pixels) per step, L2 on log(1+x), shadowed pixels weighted 10 (visibility = binary diffuse_direct), Adam lr 1e-3, StepLR(50 epochs, 0.5), 250 epochs, validation-best checkpoint by val_psnr
code_facts.data: H5 per pixel: color (full GI radiance), position (normalised by the H5 AABB at load), normal, camera_dir, light_dir (per-pixel random directional light), diffuse_direct; produced in this project by experiments/8dna_deformation_replication/rna_bridge.py (worklog 22) from Mitsuba
code_facts.renderer: first hit only; radiance = selected branch x light weight; no path continuation
code_facts.identity: upstream has no part/surface identity: one model per asset, positions in one asset frame

ownership_contract.unit: a surface domain of one part, fixed by a partition of the canonical asset surface
ownership_contract.owned_state: one complete upstream NeuralSurfaceTriPlane per unit (its own triplane framed on the unit's domain AABB + 2% margin, its own MLP); no learned parameter is shared between units
ownership_contract.evaluation_domain: the unit's surface domain: owner(x) = label of the nearest of 1 000 000 area-uniform surface samples (rso_partition.Owner)
ownership_contract.composition: each query is evaluated by its owner only (selection, never a sum)
ownership_contract.update_boundary: all parameters of a unit; a unit update cannot touch another unit's parameters
ownership_contract.preservation: units not updated keep bit-identical parameters and outputs
ownership_contract.physics: each unit is supervised by full-scene GI of its own surface (the same H5 targets); ownership does not make transport independent of the rest of the scene

partitions.P1: one unit (implementation check of the owned path, not bit-identical to A because of the 2% AABB margin)
partitions.P4: one unit per part (object-level ownership; the coarse-grained instance)
partitions.P16: surface domains: per part k-means (seed 0) over area-uniform samples, k by area: tray 9, tea pot 4, milk pot 2, tin 1

capacity.matched: per unit: triplane resolution = round(512 x unit largest extent / dataset AABB largest extent) clamped to [64, 512] (same texel size as A); MLP width = round(512 / sqrt(K)) with the same depth (summed MLP parameters equal to A's); all other model params as A
capacity.unmatched_diagnostic: P16w: P16 with every unit at A's full size (512^2 triplane, width-512 MLP); reported as a capacity diagnostic only

C1_canonical.scene: teaset T0, common-light regime (worklog 22, lighting rev 3), Ni_palik Beckmann alpha 0.05 (tray, tea pot) / 0.1 (milk pot, tin)
C1_canonical.data: worklog-22 H5: teaset_T0_train.h5 sha256 2d4a7d17..., teaset_T0_val.h5 sha256 516ecf4c... (200 / 40 views, 512^2, 512 spp)
C1_canonical.known_limit: RNA's static ceiling here is weak: worklog 22 val PSNR 18.87 dB, G1 margin 4%; worklog 27's rebuild never satisfied the recovery rule

C2_rough.scene: the same geometry, cameras, light distribution and seeds; every part roughconductor Ni_palik alpha 0.3 (Beckmann, Mitsuba default)
C2_rough.data: rna_bridge.generate_h5 unchanged with a derived protocol: material alpha 0.3, spp 128, own output directory; 200 / 40 views at 512^2
C2_rough.reason: separates RNA's static capacity (limited on near-mirror nickel, worklogs 22/23/27) from the ownership question while keeping glossy conductor interreflection; chosen before any C2 or ownership-arm training
C2_rough.spp_note: 128 spp chosen for cost (server ~3x slower than the 5080); the rougher lobe lowers per-pixel variance; reported, not tuned

arms.A: upstream NeuralSurfaceTriplaneModule, upstream config (rna_teaset_T0.yml values), seed 0
arms.REINIT: ownership test from the trained P16: re-initialise unit u* = the P16 tea-pot unit with the most training pixels, freeze every other unit (requires_grad False), train only u* with the same contract (250 epochs); the other 15 units must stay bit-identical (parameters and validation outputs)

training: every arm: the upstream contract above (250 epochs, Adam 1e-3, StepLR 50 / 0.5, log-L2, visibility weight 10), seed 0, validation-best checkpoint written; the final weights (epoch 250) are evaluated (no selection on the evaluation metric)

evaluation.data: the configuration's validation H5 (40 views, one directional light per view), never used for training
metrics: RNA's val PSNR (tonemap x/(1+x), gamma 2.2) over all masked pixels
display MAE (clamp(x^(1/2.2))) overall, per part, per P16 unit
boundary vs interior display MAE: pixels whose 4-neighbourhood holds a different P16 owner (same pixel sets for every arm)
parameters per arm and per unit, training time, inference time per view, peak memory
evaluation.exports: validation views 0/10/20/30: GT, A, P4, P16, P16w; error maps; P16 owner map; boundary crops

criteria.static_credibility_C1: RNA (A) static validation error credible for later GI-change experiments if val PSNR >= 25 dB; known to fail (18.87 dB) and reported as such
criteria.ownership_fidelity: on a configuration whose A passes static credibility: P16 (matched) val PSNR >= A - 0.5 dB AND P16 display MAE <= 1.10 x A's AND P16 boundary display MAE / A's boundary display MAE <= 1.15 (no extra seam error)
criteria.ownership_semantics: REINIT: 15 frozen units bit-identical (parameters and outputs); u* validation display MAE after retraining <= 1.10 x its P16 value
criteria.thresholds_are: predeclared screening values, not physical thresholds; raw numbers reported

placement: C1 on LabServer63 (RTX 3080 Ti; worklog-22 data present, sha256 verified) while the RTX 5080 runs worklog 31; C2 data generation and C2 arms on whichever GPU is free first (generation needs Mitsuba: the 5080, or the server with the worklog-23 OptiX libraries)
out_of_scope: dependency tracking, dynamic-scene implementation, selective-update efficiency claims, Batch 2
